sentences.text:
= = = ====================
 Ratnesh Kumar @ Ratnesh Ranjan Son Of Ramashankar Rai @ Ramai Rai  R/O Village- Gaushnagar, P.S.- Mahindwara, District- Sitamarhi  ... ..
 Versus  The State of Bihar

Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Subodh Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Surendra Prasad Singh  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 2 23-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Minapur P.S. Case No. 286/2021,
registered for the offence punishable under Sections 272, 273, 420 and 120(B)/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 30(a) of the Bihar Prohibition & Excise (Amendment) Act, 2018 pending in the learned court below.
After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application.
Accordingly, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn.

However, if the petitioner surrenders before the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.3910 of 2023(2)
dt.23-03-2023 learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today and seeks regular bail,
the learned Court below would pass the order, preferably, on the same day, without being prejudiced Ratnesh Kumar @ Ratnesh Ranjan vs The State Of Bihar on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55769823/
1 by this order.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) ajay/-
U T Ratnesh Kumar @ Ratnesh Ranjan vs The State Of Bihar on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55769823/
